$comment: Client settings shared by the remote, designer, and CLI. Firmware knobs stay in include/config.h.
inactivityTimeoutMs: whole milliseconds from 0 to 2147483647. Zero disables idle and background pausing.
Human input renews the timeout; polling, motion reports, preview refreshes, and discovery don't.
Web clients also pause when hidden. Becoming visible alone doesn't reconnect; deliberate input does.
Uploads, pending commands, and calibration captures finish before pausing. Last reports and labels are retained.
The CLI's first key after pausing only reconnects. Streams wake on Enter; repeat your command once attached.
Streams without terminal input exit when idle. Use zero for an unattended recording.
Changes take effect after rebuilding the web remote or iPhone app, reloading the designer, or restarting the CLI.
